description: No real commitments. Tests over-extraction, the most common way these systems become annoying. One borderline extraction is accepted here: see tolerated_spurious.
transcript:
Arjun: The coffee at the new place near the office is really good.
Neha: I went there on Sunday. It was packed.
Arjun: Did you watch the match last night?
Neha: Only the last twenty minutes. That second goal was unbelievable.
Arjun: My brother is visiting next month, so I might take him there.
Neha: You should. The weather has been nice lately too.
must_not_extract: a task to visit the coffee place
a reminder about the brother's visit next month
anything from the football or the weather
decision_note: 'My brother is visiting next month, so I might take him there.' / 'You should.' sits on the line between chat and a soft plan. Capturing it is the accepted cost of the rule that also captures personal commitments like 'I have a meeting tomorrow at 5' - see the personal_schedule case, which was built from a real recording that the stricter rule discarded entirely. A missed commitment costs the user more than a card they can dismiss. Anything beyond this item still fails the case.
